persona.name: Kenji Morooka

occupation.title: Production Planning Department Manager (Bucho)
occupation.organization: A 400-employee auto parts manufacturer supplying Tier-1 suppliers in Kariya, Aichi
occupation.description: Runs weekly production planning reviews, supplier negotiations, and the monthly kaizen committee. Sits in 12-15 meetings a week and still writes key decisions in a leather-bound notebook he has used the same brand of for twenty years. Approves departmental purchases up to a few hundred thousand yen; anything bigger goes up the ringi chain he himself helped design.

persona.education: Mechanical engineering degree from Nagoya Institute of Technology; joined the company straight after graduation and has never left.
long_term_goals: Hand the department to his deputy in good shape before retirement
See the new production line project through to launch
Walk the Kumano Kodo with his wife after he turns 60
Keep his section's defect rate the lowest in the company
persona.style: Speaks slowly and deliberately, often pausing before answering as if weighing the question on a scale. Prefers face-to-face conversation and distrusts anything that cannot be printed and stamped. Softens disagreement with phrases like 'sore wa dou kana' rather than saying no outright, but his no is final once given.

traits: Quietly proud of his handwritten records
Uncomfortable admitting unfamiliarity with new tools

interests: Meeting minutes as a formal record (gijiroku culture)
likes: Decisions with a clear paper trail
Tools that work without a manual
Morning radio taiso with the floor staff
Suppliers who show up in person
dislikes: Cloud services that store data 'somewhere overseas'
Young staff reading phones in meetings

beliefs: A record you did not write yourself is a record you cannot vouch for
The factory floor tells the truth; dashboards summarize it
New tools should prove themselves in someone else's department first
skills: Reading a shop floor at a glance

general: Writes meeting decisions by hand, has an admin assistant type them up
Asks 'who else is using this?' before any tool discussion
Prints email attachments to read them
Defers IT questions to the joho-shisutemu section, then quietly overrules them on his own budget

morning: 5:50 wake, NHK news over rice and miso soup
At his desk by 7:40 to review the day's meeting agendas on paper
workday: Afternoon floor walk, evening approval stamps and notebook updates
evening: One beer, sumo highlights or baseball, asleep by 23:00
weekend: Occasional golf with suppliers he actually likes

health.physical: Borderline blood pressure flagged at the annual kenshin; walks the plant enough to stay reasonably fit.
health.mental: Steady, though quietly anxious about looking out of date in front of younger managers.

relationships.name: Yoko Morooka
relationships.description: Retired elementary school teacher; handles all the household apps and laughs that he still faxes the golf club.

relationships.name: Sato-kun
relationships.description: A 38-year-old kacho who keeps gently proposing digital tools; Morooka trusts his judgment more than he lets on.
